image_description: A black and white photograph featuring a large radio telescope dish mounted on a complex truss structure. The dish is angled upwards against a dark sky. In the foreground, there is significant cloud cover or steam obscuring the base of the structure. In the background, a landscape with hills and possibly a body of water is visible. There is text in the bottom right corner.
